multi_entity_note: Three parties: WPT Enterprises, Zynga Inc. and Zynga Game Ireland, each with its own address.
processing_note: All amounts payable and due will be made in U.S. dollars.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and preamble name the contract "JOINT CONTENT LICENSE AGREEMENT".

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is "dated February 1, 2018", as the Additional Provisions repeat; 8/15/2019 is the filing date in the page footer.

contract.effective_date.rationale: February 1, 2018 is defined as the "Effective Date"; the other occurrences are the defined-term label, payment dates, filing footers, or the date of the agreement in another role.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is three years from the Effective Date, and no expiry date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 10.g says the agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California; the Northern District of California is the forum.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement automatically extends for an additional two (2) years (the "Renewal Term") if a condition is met.

contract.notice_period.rationale: The renewal is automatic and conditional on payments, and no notice to prevent it is specified.
